entries.zh: 井栏（井口的护栏／井口围边）
entries.en: well curb; the rim or parapet of a well

entries.zh: 锦；织锦（金线织物）
entries.en: brocade; figured silk woven with gold thread

entries.zh: 锦绣（织锦刺绣，华美的丝织品）
entries.en: embroidered brocade; richly figured silk

entries.zh: 锦缎（有花纹的缎子）
entries.en: brocade satin; figured satin cloth

entries.zh: 锦花缎（多花纹的锦缎）〔原件末音节污损，释义存疑〕
entries.en: flowered brocade; heavily figured brocade satin
entries.notes: M 栏第四音节 iog 标记 T99 污损难辨，仅依 L/H 栏比对释义。

entries.zh: 绣（刺绣）
entries.en: embroidery; to embroider

entries.zh: （船蛆类）蛀虫；〔按：L 栏截断，作蛆虫啃蛀木料解〕
entries.en: shipworm / wood-boring grub (broca); grub that eats wood
entries.notes: L 栏西语句截断（'…delonaues q'），与下条互补；单字头'蛸'与释义间的对应存疑。

entries.zh: 船蛆食柴（蛀蚀船木的虫，蛀吃木材）
entries.en: the broma/shipworm eats the timber; wood-boring worm (of ships)
entries.notes: L 栏西语 'Broma ç come la madera delos nauïos' 与 H 栏'蛸食柴'四栏互证。

entries.zh: 盾牌（圆盾）〔H/R 栏空缺，释义存疑〕
entries.en: buckler, round shield
entries.notes: H 栏 [空]、R 栏 [空]，仅凭 Broquel（盾）与 M 栏 sīn pāy（身牌?）推断。

entries.zh: 根；从某处生出／长出（根）
entries.en: root; to sprout, put forth shoots from some place
entries.notes: L 栏 'sabiendo de alguna parte' 原件字迹读法未定（疑 sabiendo/saliendo），对'跟(根)'的释义为推断。

entries.zh: 根走了（芽长出来，冒出来了）〔H 栏残〕
entries.en: it has sprouted, come out (of a bud/shoot)
entries.notes: H 栏标 [残]；按 L 栏 'brotaya, salio'（已长出）与 M 栏 nǔy chǎu liāu 释义。

entries.zh: 根空（树根蛀空／长出孔洞，如枝条使地生孔）
entries.en: the root is hollow; to bore out a hollow, as a branch makes a hole in the ground
entries.notes: L 栏 'como serpa agujero la tierra' 字迹读法存疑（serpa 或为 sierva/sierpe），仅按'跟空'释义。

entries.zh: 发（树木抽新枝、头发长出）
entries.en: to sprout, as the new shoots of a tree or hair growing

entries.zh: 发热（发烧）
entries.en: to break out in fever; to have a fever

entries.zh: 发明（光发出、天明；〔引申〕显明）
entries.en: light dawns, breaks forth; to grow bright

entries.zh: 发样（树木发枝抽芽）〔M 栏末音节污损〕
entries.en: the tree puts forth shoots; to bud
entries.notes: M 栏附音节 pg pīt 标 T99 污损难辨，不能确证；依 L 栏 'Brotar el arbol' 与 H 栏'发样'释义。

entries.zh: 发出来（不管怎样都长出来、发出）
entries.en: to come out, sprout in any manner whatsoever

entries.zh: 〔树〕抽芽（疑为'柏'字，柏树发芽）〔汉字伯/柏存疑〕
entries.en: to sprout (of a tree; char. uncertain: 伯/柏)
entries.notes: H 栏'伯'标疑（伯/柏），R 栏 pē 与 M 栏 Pīg pīt 对应不明，'发'义缺字头互证。

entries.zh: 涌（水涌出、喷涌）
entries.en: to gush, spurt forth (of water) with force

entries.zh: 产（土地出产、生产）
entries.en: the earth brings forth; to produce, give birth
